gates.detail: Each counted note has the six architecture recoveries (task, remembered, forgotten, query, results, workaround + recognizability).
Distinct Phase 6 seeds: task-goa-cafe, task-goa-trip, task-concert-lights, task-houseboat.
First-break node=understand. Phase 2 nomination stands unless this is formulate/retrieve/recognize/refine.

notes.remembered: how the place felt; that it was a trip / event (G6)
notes.queryTyped: not captured on the form (G7 records first action class only)
notes.workaround: still unfound, or found by scroll / a person / another app — not by a precise keyword (G9)
notes.recognizableIf: Photos takes how the place felt, or the trip without the town name (G8)

synthesis: n=6 S2 via the Google Form. People remember place vibe / trip and have forgotten date, album, and town. Photos should take the fragment they still have (G8). Stories end unfound or via scroll / a person / another app — not a precise keyword (G9). First-break node: understand. Phase 6 seeds: task-goa-cafe, task-goa-trip, task-concert-lights, task-houseboat. Query typed and result-grid were not on the form (instrument gaps, labeled not-recovered on those themes).
